identificationModule.briefTitle: Degarelix in the Treatment of Endometriosis Recurrence
identificationModule.officialTitle: Treatment With Long Acting GnRH Antagonist Degarelix in Women With Endometriosis Recurrence

leadSponsor.name: Centre for Endocrinology and Reproductive Medicine, Italy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The long acting GnRH antagonist degarelix will be tested for the treatment of women with endometriosis recurrence compared with classical GnRH analog treatment. Pain symptom disappearance and disease free time during follow-up will be the outcomes for establishing which medical treatment is the best in endometriosis recurrence treatment.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Endometriosis is a chronic disease affecting 5-10% of women in reproductive age, showing recurrence after surgery at least in 20-50% after 5 years of follow-up. The long acting GnRH antagonist degarelix, which do not have the flare-up effect at the opposite of GnRH agonist and strongly suppress LH secretion and thecal cell activity may show a better effects on endometrial implants than GnRH agonist.

armGroups.label: Degarelix

interventions.name: Leuprolide Acetate 11.25 MG/ML (Enantone 11,25)
interventions.description: 180 women will be treated with leuprolide acetate11.25 only once covering three months

primaryOutcomes.description: time without pain symptoms due to the disease recurrence

secondaryOutcomes.description: time needed during treatment to improve the pain symptoms

otherOutcomes.description: endometriosis lesions regression during treatment evidenced by MRI scan

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women affected by endometriosis showing recurrence of pain symptoms
* previous surgery for endometriosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* presence of other systemic diseases
